passage:
questionnaire — 问卷
"We can either give out a questionnaire or interview a few students." The group discussed the options for a week.

capture — 捕捉，记录
Although questionnaires are useful, they cannot capture detailed personal stories.

volunteers — 志愿者
The students agreed to use both methods: a questionnaire for all 30 students and interviews with five volunteers.

analyzed — 分析
After collecting the data, the team analyzed the results.

sample — 样本
However, because of the small sample size, the results may not apply to all students.

limitations — 局限性
Chen, reminded them to be honest about limitations.

topic sentence — 主题句
They used a topic sentence for each section.

supporting sentences — 支持句
They also practiced supporting sentences with reasons and examples.
